description: Ten-second operational overview. Real traffic only by default.

panels.description: REAL DATA = at least one real exporter sent flows in the last 5 minutes. IDLE = real exporters known, but no recent flows (not proof of failure). NO REAL EXPORTER DATA = nothing from a real exporter in 24 h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(active > 0, 2, known > 0, 1, 0) AS s FROM (
     SELECT uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')) AS active, uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')) AS known
     FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)

panels.title: STATUS

panels.description: Exporters that sent flows in the last 5 minutes / exporters seen in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(toString(uniqExactIf(ExporterAddress, TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)), ' / ', toString(uniqExact(ExporterAddress))) AS v
   FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')

panels.title: ACTIVE EXPORTERS

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

panels.description: Highest rate in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(bps) FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS t, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY t)

panels.title: PEAK TRAFFIC

panels.description: Flow records received per second (5-minute average).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count()/300 AS fps FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}'))

panels.title: FLOW RATE

panels.description: Seconds since the newest flow record (raw table, last 24 h, same data scope as every other panel).

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all')

panels.title: LAST REAL FLOW

panels.description: Direction is derived from verified interface boundary metadata: External → Internal = enters through an external interface. "Unclassified" = neither side is marked external. Nothing is guessed.

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'External → Internal', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'Internal → External', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'External → External', 'Unclassified') AS direction, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time

panels.title: Traffic by direction

panels.description: ACTIVE: flows in the last 5 min. IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS: seen in the last 7 days but quiet — this is not proof of failure (NetFlow alone cannot prove a router is down). Traffic and flows/s are 5-minute averages.

defaults.noValue: No exporter has sent flows in the last 7 days (for the selected data scope)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.exporter AS Exporter,
          multiIf(isNull(r.age), 'UNKNOWN', ifNull(x.age, r.age) <= 300, 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
          ifNull(x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, ifNull(x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, ifNull(x.age, r.age) AS `Last flow`
   FROM (SELECT ExporterName AS exporter, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s
         WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY exporter) AS r
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS exporter, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age
              FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY exporter) AS x ON r.exporter = x.exporter
   ORDER BY `Last flow`

panels.title: Exporters

panels.description: Average rate over the selected range (max 24 h). Network = name from Akvorado network definitions, "—" if not defined. Click an IP to filter Top Talkers.

defaults.noValue: No flows in the selected scope (raw data: latest 24 h)

value.title: Filter this dashboard on this IP

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ipaddr AS IP, nm AS Network, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '') AS ipaddr, if(any(SrcNetName) = '', '—', any(SrcNetName)) AS nm, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes
     FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND ('${src_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${src_ip}') AND ('${dst_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${dst_ip}') GROUP BY ipaddr)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 6

targets.rawSql:
SELECT conv AS Conversation, app AS Service, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT concat(replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', ''), ' → ', replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')) AS conv, concat(multiIf(Proto=6,'TCP',Proto=17,'UDP',Proto=1,'ICMP',concat('proto ',toString(Proto))), '/', toString(DstPort), if(transform(DstPort, [22,23,25,53,67,80,110,123,143,161,162,179,389,443,445,514,993,995,1194,3306,3389,5001,5060,8080,8443], ['SSH','Telnet','SMTP','DNS','DHCP','HTTP','POP3','NTP','IMAP','SNMP','SNMP trap','BGP','LDAP','HTTPS','SMB','Syslog','IMAPS','POP3S','OpenVPN','MySQL','RDP','iperf','SIP','HTTP-alt','HTTPS-alt'], '') = '', '', concat(' (', transform(DstPort, [22,23,25,53,67,80,110,123,143,161,162,179,389,443,445,514,993,995,1194,3306,3389,5001,5060,8080,8443], ['SSH','Telnet','SMTP','DNS','DHCP','HTTP','POP3','NTP','IMAP','SNMP','SNMP trap','BGP','LDAP','HTTPS','SMB','Syslog','IMAPS','POP3S','OpenVPN','MySQL','RDP','iperf','SIP','HTTP-alt','HTTPS-alt'], ''), ')'))) AS app, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes
     FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND ('${src_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${src_ip}') AND ('${dst_ip}'='' OR replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '^::ffff:', '')='${dst_ip}') GROUP BY conv, app)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 6

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label AS ASN, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic, round(100*bytes/sum(bytes) OVER (), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT multiIf(SrcAS = 0, 'Private / Unknown ASN', SrcAS BETWEEN 64496 AND 64511, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (lab / documentation)'), SrcAS BETWEEN 64512 AND 65534, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (private)'), SrcAS BETWEEN 4200000000 AND 4294967294, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' (private)'), concat('AS', toString(SrcAS))) AS label, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY label)
   ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Top applications / ports

defaults.noValue: No traffic in the selected scope

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arr.1 AS Protocol, round(arr.2*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS Traffic, round(100*arr.2/greatest(1, t + u + i + o), 1) AS Share FROM (
     SELECT sumIf(b, c = 'TCP') AS t, sumIf(b, c = 'UDP') AS u, sumIf(b, c = 'ICMP') AS i, sumIf(b, c = 'Other') AS o FROM (
       SELECT multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', 'Other') AS c, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS b FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${iface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${iface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY c))
   ARRAY JOIN [('TCP', t), ('UDP', u), ('ICMP', i), ('Other', o)] AS arr
